scope: fixed 4427 long-history cohort; train before day286; validation day286 inclusive to day293 exclusive; no test metrics
global_popularity: all cohort train event counts descending, then mapped ID ascending; all IDs1..N eligible; OOV target gets zero
daily_first: existing first chronological event per user and occupied day, before catalogue mapping
daily_uniform: one uniformly selected observed validation event per same user/day using numpy.default_rng seeded from sha256([music-data-audit-v1,42,uid,day]); selection before target mapping
contexts: last1152 events strictly earlier than selected target timestamp, recent128 final occupied slots; tied earlier sequence events at same timestamp omitted
frequency_recent128: frequency descending, last occurrence descending, mapped ID ascending; other catalogue items filled by train-only global order
train_sample: 32 uniformly selected eligible train positions per user without replacement, first1152positions excluded; diagnostics only, no popularity performance evaluated on these samples
session_proxy: gap at least1800 seconds from immediately preceding chronological event; descriptive proxy, not observed session labels
aggregation: ranking macro-user mean over selected occupied days; report anchor fractions and macro-user repeat fractions separately
